summary: Russia launched a massive combined attack on Kyiv killing 15 and injuring over 30, damaging residential areas, a school, and a children's hospital. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 186 of 212 aerial targets overnight. Ukraine retaliated by striking Russian energy infrastructure including an oil refinery in Tatarstan, an oil terminal in Krasnodar Krai, and the Primorsko-Akhtarsk airfield used for Shahed launches.
key_points: Russian massive combined attack on Kyiv killed 15, injured 30+, damaged residential buildings, school, children's hospital in three districts. (Source: @UkraineNow/83554, @UkraineNow/83567)
Ukrainian air defense intercepted 186 of 212 aerial targets overnight, including a cruise missile downed by border guards with a machine gun near Kyiv. (Source: @UkraineNow/83562, @UkraineNow/83564)

Ukraine struck Russian energy infrastructure: oil refinery in Tatarstan, oil terminal and substation in Krasnodar Krai, fire at Primorsko-Akhtarsk airfield, explosions in Tambov and Moscow region, blackout in Crimea. (Source: @UkraineNow/83563)
Russian missile production exceeds 200 cruise/ballistic missiles monthly; stockpiles: 600 Onyx, 450 Kalibr, 120 Zircon, 130 Iskander-M, ~50 Kinzhal, ~50 KN-23. (Source: @UkraineNow/83566)
Two Russian POWs escaped from Petrivske colony in Kharkiv region, killed a Ukrainian soldier, seized weapon and Mercedes. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32589)
Widespread Shahed UAV activity across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Odesa, Vinnytsia, Kirovohrad, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, Kharkiv regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70796, @kpszsu/73595, @eRadarrua/106337)
Russian Southern Grouping destroyed two AFU vehicles and a ground robot in DNR; DeepState map shows advances near Kalenyky and Tsvetkove. (Source: @tass_agency/391237, @DeepStateUA/23757)
Queues at Upper Lars border crossing (Russia-Georgia) ~20k people daily, cars moving 100m per 2 hours. (Source: @UkraineNow/83547)

points: Ukrainian air defense shot down 186 of 212 aerial targets during overnight massive attack, including a cruise missile downed by border guards with a machine gun near Kyiv; debris fell outside populated areas. (Source: @UkraineNow/83562, @UkraineNow/83564)

Ukraine conducted retaliatory strikes on Russian energy infrastructure: oil refinery in Tatarstan, oil terminal and substation in Krasnodar Krai, fire at Primorsko-Akhtarsk military airfield (Shahed launch site), explosions reported in Tambov and Moscow regions, blackout in Crimea. (Source: @UkraineNow/83563)

State Bureau of Investigation (DBR) launched large-scale operation against abuses in military units targeting servicemen formally on duty but illegally receiving payments or working for commanders' private interests, including construction work. (Source: @UkraineNow/83568)
Anti-corruption authorities confirmed Zelensky's deputy head of office Iryna Mudraya part of corrupt criminal group; she was dismissed, home and office searched. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32583)
Protesters gathered outside Parliament shouting "Shame!" at appointment of Yevhen Khmara as Defense Minister. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32577)
Former Defense Minister Fedorov may travel to US next week to seek American support per Guardian report. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32592)
Russia returned location data for 79 Ukrainian servicemen previously considered missing; Lubinets confirmed. (Source: @UkraineNow/83552)

Russian military-industrial complex produces over 200 cruise/ballistic missiles monthly; current stockpiles: 600 Onyx, 450 Kalibr, 120 Zircon, 130 Iskander-M, ~50 Kinzhal, ~50 North Korean KN-23 per GUR data. (Source: @UkraineNow/83566)

Massive combined attack on Kyiv overnight killed 15, injured 30+, damaged Solomiansky, Svyatoshynsky, Darnytsky districts: warehouses, residential buildings, school, children's hospital; large fires at industrial sites in Boryspil and Brovary districts. (Source: @UkraineNow/83554, @UkraineNow/83567)
Russian Southern Grouping destroyed two AFU vehicles and a ground robot in DNR per Ministry of Defense video. (Source: @tass_agency/391237)
North Korea launched presumed ballistic missile toward Japan per Japan Coast Guard. (Source: @tass_agency/391214)
Queues at Upper Lars border crossing (Russia-Georgia) ~20k people daily, cars moving 100m per 2 hours; speculation about mobilization fears. (Source: @UkraineNow/83547)
Russian forces advanced near Kalenyky and Tsvetkove per DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23757)
